- **Age:** presumed seventy anyhow  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an elderly woman with wrinkled cheeks. She has sharp black eyes that twinkle through her gold-rimmed glasses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

A prim and proper lady, Josephine Barry is known to be rather selfish, rarely caring for anyone other than herself. Despite these traits, she can also be a most hospitable host who treats her guests royally.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## History

Josephine Barry was a rich, seventy-year-old aunt of Mr. Barry who lived at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). During a visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she was infuriated when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) leaped into her spare-room bed, but she forgave the girls and remained in town after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a sincere, imaginative apology that amused her and struck up a friendship. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) home during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), realizing how much she enjoyed Anne's lively company.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Quotes

> “I’m afraid my imagination is a little rusty—it’s so long since I used it,” she said. “I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself.”
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> “I’ve made up my mind to stay simply for the sake of getting better acquainted with that Anne-girl,” she said frankly. “She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity.”
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "but I guess she didn’t make much of a mistake after all. If I’d a child like Anne in the house all the time I’d be a better and happier woman."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P32](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0032)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry forms a warm friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally apologizes for accidentally jumping on her in bed during a sleepover. Anne's dramatic and honest confession amuses Josephine, prompting her to forgive the children and prolong her stay. They become firm friends who converse and entertain one another, with Josephine hosting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and welcoming her visits while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), +18 more_

- Friend of — firm friends who talk and amuse each other  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's elderly aunt. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits her aunt's home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011)_
